    # naive: find lines starting at col 0 with '{' ... matching at col 0 '}'

        depth += l.count('{') - l.count('}')
        if depth <= 0:
            funcs.append((cur_start, i))

    l = re.sub(r'//.*', '', l)
    l = re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', l)
